description: This file defines the RepoManager class, which manages repositories in an Android application, including loading, enabling/disabling, deleting, and updating repositories, as well as handling repository previews and mirrors.

classes.name: RepoManager
classes.description: Manages repositories, including loading, enabling/disabling, deleting, and updating repositories, as well as handling repository previews and mirrors.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns a repository by ID, blocking if repositories are not yet loaded.

methods.name: getRepositories
methods.description: Returns the list of repositories, blocking if not yet loaded.

methods.name: setRepositoryEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a repository and its archive if applicable.

methods.name: deleteRepository
methods.description: Deletes a repository and its archive from the database and updates internal state.

methods.name: fetchRepositoryPreview
methods.description: Fetches a preview of a repository from a URL, with optional proxy.

methods.name: addFetchedRepository
methods.description: Adds a fetched repository to the database after preview is complete.

methods.name: abortAddingRepository
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing repository preview fetch.

methods.name: setPreferredRepoId
methods.description: Sets the preferred repository ID for a package.

methods.name: reorderRepositories
methods.description: Reorders repositories to change their priority.

methods.name: setArchiveRepoEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the archive repository for a given repository.

methods.name: isSwapUri
methods.description: Checks if a URI belongs to a swap repository.

methods.name: setMirrorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a mirror for a repository.

methods.name: deleteUserMirror
methods.description: Removes a user-defined mirror from a repository.
